name: Stitch & Thread
summary: Metrics cross-stitched in teal on linen; a seam ripper unpicks the coral stitches where checkout conversion dropped.
look: Oat linen, a wooden embroidery hoop, glossy teal cross-stitches with thread highlights, a silver needle and sewn fabric labels. Coral thread marks the anomaly.

components.name: Weave ground
components.role: oat linen texture from two fine repeating gradients

components.name: Stitch cell
components.role: two diagonal thread strokes + a highlight — one data pixel

components.name: Needle + running thread
components.role: the agent: a silver sliver leading each row, trailing a thread path

components.name: Seam ripper
components.role: the anomaly tool; pulls out the coral stitches

components.name: Sewn label
components.role: fabric tag with a dashed stitch border for the anomaly details

components.name: Sewn button
components.role: a four-hole button on a fabric tag — the human action

motion.name: Stitch-reveal
motion.how: per-cell stroke-dashoffset on steps() at 12 fps, 0.03 s stagger; a row completes every beat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Needle bob
motion.how: 0.15 s sine up/down ahead of the stitch front, locked to sixteenth notes

motion.name: Unpick
motion.how: coral thread pulls out with power2.in 0.3 s on the snare, then re-stitches teal over the next bar

story: Hook: a hoop full of cross-stitched mini dashboards fills in, one with a coral dip. Reveal: the hoop tightens on the drop around a stitched Acme mark patch and a satin “Acme Pulse”. Proof: a teal line chart stitches across until it drops into coral; the ripper unpicks it, a sewn label reads “Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231”, and the human presses the “Roll back” button. CTA: the linen drapes in with “Every metric. Every minute.” and a stitched “Start free” tag.
adapt: Stitch your product's key chart or icon grid, let your agent be the needle, and turn the one thing it catches into the coral stitches that get unpicked; primary actions become sewn buttons.

references.note: stitched / textile animation in a fashion film
physics-based cloth for the drape reveal

fit.risk: Stitched digits get noisy; keep them large and few and set exact values as typeset labels.
